CIVN-2026-0566
**Multiple Vulnerabilities in GitLab products**
Original Issue Date:November 20, 2026
Severity Rating: HIGH
Software Affected
- GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE): Versions prior to 19.3.9, 19.4.8 and 19.5.6
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in GitLab CE and EE products which could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code, obtain sensitive information, bypass security restrictions, or cause denial of service (DoS) conditions on the targeted system.
**Target Audience:**
All organizations and individuals using GitLab CE and EE products.
**Risk Assessment:**
High risk of unauthorized access, sensitive information disclosure, authorization bypass and service disruption due to multiple security vulnerabilities.
**Impact Assessment:**
Successful exploitation could compromise the confidentiality, integrity and availability of affected systems.
Description
GitLab is a DevSecOps platform used for source code management, version control, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), project management and software development collaboration.
Multiple vulnerabilities exist in GitLab CE and EE due to cross-site scripting (XSS), improper authorization, access control weakness, path traversal, improper input validation, null pointer dereference, server-side request forgery (SSRF) and other security weaknesses. A remote attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a specially crafted request to the targeted system or by persuading a victim to visit a specially crafted webpage.





Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, obtain sensitive information, bypass security restrictions, access restricted files or directories, cause denial of service (DoS) conditions or perform spoofing on the targeted system.

Solution
Apply appropriate security updates and mitigations as recommended by the vendor.


[https://docs.gitlab.com/releases/patches/patch-release-gitlab-19-5-6-released/](https://docs.gitlab.com/releases/patches/patch-release-gitlab-19-5-6-released/)
